# Problem codes: Submodels and libraries

Submodel definitions and instances, asset libraries and catalogues. The list is generated from the codes' own table; the meaning is the table's sentence for the code.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="e_asset_block_type"></span>`E_ASSET_BLOCK_TYPE` | error | An asset uses a block type this build does not register (needs a plugin). | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_code"></span>`E_ASSET_CODE` | error | A library carries executable content (custom_logic, a plugin reference, Python). | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_definition"></span>`E_ASSET_DEFINITION` | error | An asset's definition is invalid by the ordinary model validator. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_geometry"></span>`E_ASSET_GEOMETRY` | error | An asset's "geometry" fragment is malformed, or a block inside it binds to a node the fragment does not declare. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_graphic"></span>`E_ASSET_GRAPHIC` | error | A graphic names an unknown state, or its SVG is unsafe or over the size cap. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_id"></span>`E_ASSET_ID` | error | An asset has an empty or duplicate id. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_migration"></span>`E_ASSET_MIGRATION` | error | An asset's "migrations" entry is malformed: a bad semver range, an unknown step, or a step naming a parameter this version lacks. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_parameter"></span>`E_ASSET_PARAMETER` | error | A parameter's type, default, range or choices are inconsistent. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_requires"></span>`E_ASSET_REQUIRES` | error | An asset's required model-level records name an unknown section, or are malformed. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_test"></span>`E_ASSET_TEST` | error | An asset test entry is malformed. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_test_failed"></span>`E_ASSET_TEST_FAILED` | error | An asset test's KPI is outside its tolerance. | -- |
| <span id="e_asset_unknown_name"></span>`E_ASSET_UNKNOWN_NAME` | error | A definition expression names something that is no parameter, variable or built-in (often a misspelt parameter). | -- |
| <span id="e_catalogue_column"></span>`E_CATALOGUE_COLUMN` | error | A catalogue row is missing a declared column, or a preset maps a column the catalogue does not declare. | -- |

| <span id="e_extends_unknown"></span>`E_EXTENDS_UNKNOWN` | error | A definition's `extends` names no definition in the model (or an asset's, no asset of the same library). | -- |

## How to fix

The codes seen most often, each with the usual remedy:

- `E_SUBMODEL`: Read the message for the definition that failed to flatten. The usual causes are a missing definition, an argument the definition does not declare, or a link to a port that does not exist.
